agent.reasons: Mateo Brandt is the CEO, the control person and a 26% owner. He has a potential sanctions match that has not been cleared, which requires escalation under 4.2. The entity is also a money services business whose state licence has not been verified, so the 5.3 exception does not apply and 5.2 requires escalation as well. All other checks pass. Ownership is complete: the direct owners hold 26%, 25% and 23%, and the owners behind Nimbus Holdings hold 7.8% and 18.2% indirectly. Every identified individual is verified, the registry filing (2025-11-16) is less than 12 months old, and the entity and all individuals are in the US. Under 2.1 the most severe outcome, escalate, governs.
still_needed: Clearance or confirmation of Mateo Brandt's potential sanctions match
Verification of the entity's state MSB licence
Records of the adverse media searches (terms, date, sources), as required by 4.4
